text:
Ashwin: starting staggered backfill for customer_profiles -> add `last_active` (timestamp) + TTL index on last_active. Maintenance window 40m. kicking @deploybot to start chunked backfill (2k chunks). pls ack and monitor.

deploybot: queued migration: mig-1767554321-stager on dbpool-2. running chunked backfill chunk_size=2000, pause_on: lock_wait>8s or replica_lag>40s sustained>75s. streaming logs: https://deployments.internal/logs/mig-1767554321-stager :robot_face:

Maria: quick check 1: are there any analytic exports touching customer_profiles in the next hour?

Jordan: there was a small report at :30, moved earlier. i'm throttling report-writer and draining read replica rr-us-west-2 for 10m: `/throttle job report-writer --table=customer_profiles --rate=0.15` and `/drain-rr rr-us-west-2 --table=customer_profiles --timeout=10m`

Sam: adding to release notes: "Add last_active + TTL index; backfill performed during maintenance window with staged rollout. Clients unaffected for reads." pinning release ref v2.1.2-canary.

SRE-Oncall: need precise pause vs rollback triggers and an escape hatch command to abort the migration quickly. Also request temporary alerts for p95 write latency and replica lag.

Ashwin: agreed. Pause (soft hold) triggers: any chunk lock_wait >8s OR replica_lag >40s sustained >75s OR p95 write latency >300ms for >2m -> deploybot will pause and post holdpin. Rollback triggers: migration job exits non-zero twice OR sustained write error_rate >35% for 5m OR customer error rate uptick >2% for 3m. Escape hatch: `release:unpin-mig-1767554321-stager` to abort the run and pin rollback. Quick rollback steps (fast):
```
# stop migrator service
systemctl stop migrator.service || true
# terminate active ALTERs
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ~ 'ALTER TABLE customer_profiles' AND state <> 'active';
# revert schema
ALTER TABLE customer_profiles DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS last_active;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_customer_profiles_last_active_ttl;
```
Full runbook: /runbooks/migrations/customer_profiles.md.

deploybot: acknowledged. current progress: processed_rows=6040; throughput ~92 rows/s; no pause conditions hit. perf snapshot posted to metrics.

Maria: if we see latency blips i'll run `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` on the active chunk and paste the plan. doing a sanity check on a sample chunk now.

Jordan: read replica drain done, observed lag ~7-9s during drain. continuing to tail.

Sam: noted. will add rollout gating line: TTL enforcement enabled after 14 days and opt-in validation.

SRE-Oncall: setting temporary alert rule: alert if write_latency_p95 > 350ms OR replica_lag > 60s. will mute non-critical alerts for the window.

Ashwin: thanks team. next checkpoint at 25k rows processed or on any holdpin/rollback. standing by.
